name: comp-319
title: Terms Acceptance Dialog
description: A trigger opens a narrow dialog of legal text. An outlined Cancel sits beside a dimmed I agree that only lights up once the body is scrolled to the bottom.
use: You must record explicit acceptance of long terms and want to push readers to the end.
avoid: The gate only checks scroll position, so it can be bypassed and proves nothing was read.
a11y: The dialog traps focus and Escape closes it, but nothing announces that I agree has unlocked after scrolling. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Closed, a single outlined button. Open, a tall dark rounded dialog: a bordered title bar reading Terms & Conditions, dense small legal paragraphs with bold clause names, and a bordered footer with a grey hint plus Cancel and I agree.
behaves: Scrolling the body toward the bottom flips I agree from dim and disabled to an active button, and the footer hint disappears. Cancel or Escape closes the dialog.
customise: Every clause, heading and label is hardcoded; the only logic is a scroll check and an enabled flag.
weight: light: One dialog with a scroll listener; no animation beyond the opening fade.
